answer: The Proof of Activity (PoA) mechanism resists Sybil attacks by requiring AI agents to stake a portion of their tokens, which are then used to secure the network through a proof-of-work (PoW) process, generating a unique ripple effect. This process is analogous to the rare saffron spice, which is difficult to replicate, and the tundra environment, where only the most resilient species can thrive, thereby discouraging malicious actors from creating fake identities.
